These nine patients, aged 10−32 years, had fever, cough, pleural effusion, and eosinophilia.

methods_quotes.q: Clinical information and exposure histories were collected through medical record review and interviews of patients and the parents of a patient by attending physicians.
Serum samples were tested for Paragonimus antibodies by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) at a commercial laboratory or by immunoblot assay at CDC.
